result.summary: Independently re-derived verdict from git show ab611473 (full diff, all 13 files read directly) rather than trusting step-01's narrative. (1) Idiom/OTP/supervision: not applicable -- this is a pure documentation change to lib/letflow/design/*.md, no code, no gen_statem/supervision surface touched. (2) Marker placement: verified against REQ-237 section 2's structural rule across all observed unit shapes -- single citation line, paragraph, bulleted list item, table, and the H1-title-as-first-line edge case (req049-variable-merge.md and req062-sub-process-runtime.md both have the marker inserted as the literal first line, immediately before the H1/title line, matching the REQ-264 precedent exactly). (3) Additive-only: re-ran grep -c '\.zig' myself on all 13 files post-change -- 9/28/12/4/2/3/17/5/9/17/3/11/21, identical to the step-00 baseline in every file, no drift. Hand-read req062-sub-process-runtime.md's diff specifically (the one file with apparent deletions, 16 changed lines) -- the 3 bulleted R-Co citation lines (transition.zig:1903, transition.zig:1448, instance.zig:4681) are each re-indented one level to nest under an inline '* PROVENANCE (...):' bullet prefix rather than getting their own preceding standalone line, which keeps the Markdown list syntax valid; original citation text (path, line numbers, prose) is preserved verbatim in every case, just shifted right by the list-continuation indent -- not a content loss. (4) Divergence-note text: grep for the literal single-line pattern returns nothing in req066-api-error-response.md both before and after because 'This diverges from R-Co.' wraps across a markdown line break in both versions; read both versions directly with grep -A2 and confirmed the three-line span is byte-for-byte identical before (git show 49ecdd26) and after, only shifted down by marker insertions elsewhere in the file -- confirms no alteration. (5) Scope: git show ab611473 --stat over the full commit shows only the 13 named files plus handoffs/WF02-REQ267-20260906/step01-doc-updater.json and handoffs/registry.json changed -- no file outside the owned_modules list was touched, and no sibling chunk's files (238/239 series) leaked in. (6) No scope creep: no new abstraction, no styling variant, no second marker convention invented -- every insertion is the fixed literal 'PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):' string per REQ-237 section 2, applied mechanically. This is the same shape as the already-merged REQ-264 precedent and holds to the same bar.
